goals.name: CRM Hygiene Goal Harness
goals.description: CRM Hygiene Goal Harness [ops-crm-hygiene] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hD-03-crm-hygiene.yaml
goals.gate: Backup, schema snapshot, and rollback plan exist and are hashed in proofpacket.json

gates.name: 0.1 Twenty CRM reachable and its object inventory enumerated bef
gates.description: Twenty CRM reachable and its object inventory enumerated before any analysis
gates.command: curl -sf http://localhost:3000/healthz exit 0; artifacts/crm/<run>/objects.json lists people, companies, opportunities with counts

gates.name: 0.2 Hygiene scope declared: which objects, which fields, which d
gates.description: Hygiene scope declared: which objects, which fields, which defect classes this run addresses
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/scope.md lists objects, fields, defect_classes (duplicates | missing_fields | stale_stage | orphans)

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated (L1, L3, L4; D1-D2; A1-A2)
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated (L1, L3, L4; D1-D2; A1-A2)
gates.command: coordinate block in ~/.hermes/jake/crm/session-<ts>.log parseable by jq

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_crm declared with all 7 components
gates.description: Harness tuple H_crm declared with all 7 components

gates.name: 1.1 Pre-mutation backup of every in-scope object exported to dis
gates.description: Pre-mutation backup of every in-scope object exported to disk
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/backup/ contains <object>.json per in-scope object; row counts match objects.json counts; shasum -a 256 manifest written

gates.name: 1.2 Schema snapshot captured: current field definitions per obje
gates.description: Schema snapshot captured: current field definitions per object so mutations are checked against the real schema, not memory
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/schema_snapshot.json diffed by scripts/schema_diff.py; session log records snapshot hash

gates.name: 1.3 Rollback procedure written BEFORE the first mutation: exact
gates.description: Rollback procedure written BEFORE the first mutation: exact commands to restore from backup
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/rollback.md contains executable restore commands referencing backup/ files

gates.name: 2.1 Duplicate detection run: exact email match + fuzzy name+doma
gates.description: Duplicate detection run: exact email match + fuzzy name+domain match, results ranked by confidence
gates.command: python3 scripts/find_duplicates.py --crm http://localhost:3000 --out duplicates.json exit 0; report shows candidate_count and confidence tiers

gates.name: 2.2 Missing-field report: required fields per stage definition (
gates.description: Missing-field report: required fields per stage definition (email, owner, next_step, amount where applicable) with null counts
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/missing_fields.json with per-field null_count and affected record ids; jq 'keys | length >= 3' true

gates.name: 2.3 Stale-stage detection: opportunities with no activity > 30 d
gates.description: Stale-stage detection: opportunities with no activity > 30 days flagged with last_activity timestamps
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/stale.json entries each carry record_id and days_inactive; all days_inactive > 30

gates.name: 2.4 Orphan detection: people without company, opportunities with
gates.description: Orphan detection: people without company, opportunities without owner or next_step
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/orphans.json grouped by orphan_type with counts

gates.name: 3.1 Every proposed mutation expressed as a dry-run plan file bef
gates.description: Every proposed mutation expressed as a dry-run plan file before execution: operation, record ids, before/after field values
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/mutation_plan.jsonl — each line {op, record_id, before, after}; scripts/dryrun_mutations.py validates all lines exit 0

gates.name: 3.2 Human approval for destructive classes: merges and deletions
gates.description: Human approval for destructive classes: merges and deletions never execute from a plan file without an APPROVE line
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/approve.log contains APPROVE <run_id> <class> for each destructive class executed; absent approval those lines are skipped and logged

gates.name: 3.3 Post-mutation verification queries re-run the original defec
gates.description: Post-mutation verification queries re-run the original defect detectors and show improvement or explicit residual list
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/post_verify.json compared to pre-run defects; defect_count_after <= defect_count_before; residual items each have reason codes

gates.name: 3.4 Audit trail: every executed mutation logged with timestamp,
gates.description: Audit trail: every executed mutation logged with timestamp, operator, plan-line hash
gates.command: artifacts/crm/<run>/mutation_audit.jsonl line count equals executed ops; each line sha256-matches a mutation_plan.jsonl line

preconditions.startup_phrase: CRM hygiene session. Backup before mutation, dry-run before write, verify after. The CRM is the system of record — treat it like one.
preconditions.harness_tuple: H_crm(snapshot, backup, audit, dryrun, mutation, verify, rollback)
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 mandatory for all mutations (deterministic, dry-run first); A2 for duplicate heuristics; A3/A4 never — CRM writes are never autonomous

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times; recurring defect class becomes a standing prevention rule in scope.md defaults

success_conditions: Backup, schema snapshot, and rollback plan exist and are hashed in proofpacket.json
Defect audit artifacts (duplicates, missing fields, stale, orphans) present with counts
Executed mutations verified by post-run detectors; destructive classes show approval evidence
Identity closure: coordinate, verdict (cleaned | partial | blocked), next safe action in session log
failure_states: stop gate(s) 1.1, 3.2: session halts; human Gate-D approval required before any continuation or outward action
halt gate(s) 1.2, 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 2.3, 2.4: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Twenty CRM reachable and its object inventory enumerated before any analysis
Hygiene scope declared: which objects, which fields, which defect classes this run addresses
RIG coordinate stated (L1, L3, L4; D1-D2; A1-A2)
Harness tuple H_crm declared with all 7 components
Pre-mutation backup of every in-scope object exported to disk
Schema snapshot captured: current field definitions per object so mutations are checked against the real schema, not memory
Rollback procedure written BEFORE the first mutation: exact commands to restore from backup
Duplicate detection run: exact email match + fuzzy name+domain match, results ranked by confidence
Missing-field report: required fields per stage definition (email, owner, next_step, amount where applicable) with null counts
Stale-stage detection: opportunities with no activity > 30 days flagged with last_activity timestamps
Orphan detection: people without company, opportunities without owner or next_step
Every proposed mutation expressed as a dry-run plan file before execution: operation, record ids, before/after field values
Human approval for destructive classes: merges and deletions never execute from a plan file without an APPROVE line
Post-mutation verification queries re-run the original defect detectors and show improvement or explicit residual list
Audit trail: every executed mutation logged with timestamp, operator, plan-line hash

final_rule: No mutation without backup, dry-run plan, and rollback commands on disk.
No merge or delete without typed approval for that exact class and run.
Post-run verification is the definition of done, not the intention to verify.
Every CRM hygiene session leaves the system stronger than it found it.
